medium: Painted anime-fantasy ability illustrations, dark navy background, no typography or franchise insignia

techniques.sovereignRebuke: An expanding spherical shockwave exploding outward from a bright white core, flinging chunks of stone away in every direction; powerful radial knockback, violet and pale gold.
techniques.eventideGrasp: Loose stone fragments and luminous ribbons being dragged inward into one dark violet gravitational vortex; clearly inward suction rather than an explosion.
techniques.glasswingVolley: A fan-shaped volley of sharp luminous ivory glass feathers hurtling forward on a mint wind trail; angular translucent material, ranged cutting projectiles.
techniques.prismTether: Bright hard-light ribbons refracting through prism shards and wrapping an anonymous dark training dummy torso; immobilizing restraint, not a protective shield.
techniques.rimeflash: One polished sword lunging horizontally at high speed with a sharp crimson-pink lightning trail and small blue energy sparks drawn back toward its hilt; lightning dash strike.
techniques.eclipseDrain: A dark violet eclipse ring drawing a ribbon of blue life energy from a distant small silhouette into a glowing red-violet droplet near the foreground; life and energy drain.
techniques.resonanceDrone: One small angular ceramic-and-brass winged drone diving forward, orange resonance core glowing inside its chest; explosive engineered projectile, no animal mouth.
techniques.shardMinefield: Several low ceramic resonance discs embedded in cracked earth, one exploding into hot orange fragments; hazardous ground minefield.
techniques.venomDart: One sharp needle-like dart coated in luminous lime poison flying toward the upper right, trailing a thin sickly green vapor; precision toxic projectile.
techniques.bindingThreads: Many taut golden-brown threads crossing and cinching around a dark training dummy torso silhouette, roots anchoring them to stone; clearly binding restraint.
techniques.harmoniousSlash: Precise silver-blue sword slash splitting a translucent guard barrier
techniques.aetherSiphon: A blue energy projectile shaped like a hollow siphoning spiral, pulling tiny bright energy beads backward into its trailing stream; ranged energy theft.
techniques.stoneSnare: Jagged earthen fingers and stone roots rising from a circular patch of ground to clasp an anonymous training dummy's ankles; immobilizing earth ground trap.
techniques.venomMist: A low dense lime-green toxic fog pool crawling over cracked ground, with dark floating droplets and a clearly hazardous glowing boundary; poison ground field.
techniques.horizonRush: A dark anonymous fighter silhouette streaking horizontally between two golden motion afterimages with a sharp strike flash at the destination; fast physical dash attack, no teleport portal.
techniques.fireball: One roaring spherical orange fireball hurtling diagonally toward upper right, bright molten core with a long flame tail and embers; offensive burning projectile.
techniques.dissonanceMark: A fractured violet-gold resonance ring hovering before an abstract training dummy chest; broken soundwave ribbons dim the target aura, clear weakening effect, no eyes or writing.
techniques.special1: A dense rotating blue-white sphere of compressed energy rushing forward on a sweeping tail, with tightly wound spiral bands; close-range rushing energy strike, no people.
techniques.clone: Three anonymous matching dark fighter silhouettes advancing together, the central figure solid and the others smoky blue afterimages; coordinated clone attack.
techniques.voltaicLance: A single anatomically coherent gloved hand with five fingers held in a compact spear-like thrust, wreathed in concentrated electric-blue lightning piercing a cracked translucent barrier; high-speed penetrating palm attack.
techniques.prismRam: Two closed armored gauntlets wrapped in large blue prismatic energy rams striking forward together through a translucent guard plate; forceful paired penetrating fists, no animal faces.
techniques.pulsebreaker: One compact gloved fist striking a small glowing energy point on an abstract armored training dummy torso, fractured gold-blue energy channels dimming outward; precise weakening melee strike.
techniques.fractureLens: One large floating hexagonal pearl crystal lens focusing a white beam through a cracked transparent shield; precision guard-penetration enhancement, no eyes or faces.
techniques.thornlash: Two long living thorn vines whipping forward from a bronze mechanical bracer, restrained green toxic vapor on their pointed tips; long reaching poisonous root strike, no snakes.
techniques.fivefoldLock: A gloved palm pressing five small golden light points in a circle onto an abstract armored training dummy torso, causing its aura to dim; weakening fivefold strike, no written glyphs.
techniques.stormNeedle: A concentrated electric-blue lightning edge extending from a sword-like thrust through a split translucent guard plate; crisp straight piercing bolt silhouette.
techniques.arcSentinel: One electric-blue wolf-like hound made entirely of branching lightning, leaping forward through a split transparent shield edge; piercing animal-shaped projectile.
techniques.dawnforgeImpact: One gloved fist smashing into stone with a pink-gold impact burst and rising debris, a small opponent silhouette tossed upward by the shock; powerful launching impact, no gore.
techniques.zenithHammer: One armored shin and boot delivering a high downward diagonal kick into a luminous impact burst, a small shattered aura behind it; weakening martial kick, anatomically coherent leg.
techniques.duneCrucible: A dense golden sand spiral closing into a crushing cocoon around an anonymous dark training dummy silhouette; forceful sand compression, no gore.
techniques.siroccoBarrage: A diagonal shower of many sharp golden sand pellets streaking toward a small opponent silhouette whose glowing aura fades; ranged weakening sand barrage.
techniques.ashwingAssault: A flock of three dark crows with bright violet rim light diving in a unified forward swoop, wings creating a shadowy strike trail; rushing crow assault.
techniques.umbraPyre: One dense black-violet flame projectile with glowing purple edges and a hot lavender core, licking upward as it rushes forward; persistent burning dark flame, no eye symbols.
techniques.ironstepCyclone: One bronze armored boot and shin sweeping horizontally through a mint wind crescent; fast spinning martial kick, no leaves or written markings.
techniques.heavenwardSpiral: Two anonymous dark fighter silhouettes in a tight rising grappling spiral, the target clearly being lifted upward on a gold-white energy column; close-range launcher, readable simple figures.
techniques.umbraLeash: A long dark shadow reaching across the ground from foreground toward a small training dummy silhouette, draining and dimming the dummy's golden aura; weakening shadow control, no restraint chains.
techniques.nightglassSpines: Several black-purple shadow spikes thrusting sharply forward through a fractured translucent defensive plate; piercing shadow melee attack.
techniques.bannerbreakReversal: A broad bronze round shield sweeping a violet-gold force crescent back outward through a cracked guard plate; heavy penetrating counterstrike, no war fan or insignia.
techniques.wyrmfireSurge: A rushing orange flame projectile whose leading flames form a clearly readable fierce dragon head, surrounded by embers and a trailing flame plume; burning dragon-shaped attack.
techniques.prismSlipstream: One anonymous dark fighter silhouette lunging horizontally with a compact fist forward, trailing a pale green wind stream and a few clean afterimages; rapid rushing physical strike.
techniques.veiledPulse: One pale blue spinning energy orb in flight, its trailing half dissolving into translucent fragments as the solid front pierces a thin broken guard plate; fading penetrating projectile.
techniques.coilbolt: A long serpentine ribbon of electric-blue lightning shaped like a striking snake, its pointed head driving through a cracked translucent guard plate; long-reaching piercing lightning.
techniques.galeRazor: One large crescent blade made entirely of pale mint wind streaking diagonally through the air, subtle air streams and clear sharp outer edge; ranged wind slash.
techniques.bodyBlade: An anonymous armored forearm forming a sharp bright silver blade edge, thrusting through a split translucent guard plate; bodily blade melee piercing strike, no extra fingers.
techniques.energyBlast: A compact bright coral-gold energy bolt racing forward with concentric pressure rings and a hot white impact core; ranged raw-energy blast, distinct from a blue spiral orb.
techniques.echoingRift: A jagged silver-blue rift in dark space, metallic fragments and thin resonance rings dragged inward toward the split; pulling metal-vulnerability attack, no sword held by a person.
techniques.skyforgedAegis: One steel sword held upright in a middle-guard arrangement behind overlapping silver-blue metallic shield plates, an incoming spark reflected outward along a curved trail; guard, absorption and poised sword counter.
techniques.stormheart: A vivid crimson-violet storm core pulsing inside a heart-like angular crystalline shape, electricity branching outward around it; temporary lightning-power enhancement.
techniques.tidalEdict: A forceful turquoise wave projectile curling around a luminous royal-looking fan silhouette, its forward surge washing over and dimming a small opponent outline; weakening water attack.
techniques.royalTempest: Two elegant open metallic battle fans framing a turquoise wind-and-water vortex that pulls inward toward a bright heavy impact at the center; undertow into finishing strike.
techniques.triuneFlow: An elegant open battle fan braced in front of a short sword, encircled by three flowing turquoise, gold and coral defensive currents; poised guard and counter, no impenetrable bubble.
techniques.risingGale: A pale mint wind column sweeping upward from lower left to upper right, lifting one small anonymous opponent silhouette and several leaves; unmistakable upward launcher.
techniques.skyCleave: One silver sword making a clean midair crescent slash high above a faint distant ground, blue-white upward motion trails and a small suspended target silhouette; aerial sword launcher.
techniques.floodField: A broad circular pool of turquoise floodwater spreading across a stone floor, an anonymous dummy's boots surrounded by water and sluggish circular ripples; slowing water ground field.
techniques.skyfallNeedles: A fan-shaped spread of fine turquoise water needles raining diagonally downward from above against a distant dark floor; clearly airborne downward projectile barrage.
techniques.emberField: A low circular patch of burning orange embers covering cracked ground, short licking flames and a few rising sparks; persistent burning ground field, not a flying fireball.
techniques.divingFlame: An anonymous dark fighter silhouette diving steeply downward inside a bright orange flame spear, striking the ground in a compact fire burst; aerial diving finisher.
techniques.stoneWard: Layered broad stone plates forming a solid defensive bulwark with warm amber seams and a small incoming impact absorbed at the front; temporary damage reduction, not an attack.
techniques.windVeil: An anonymous runner silhouette wrapped in flowing mint-green wind ribbons, several fading motion trails stretching behind; temporary movement speed buff.
techniques.galePush: A wide mint wind gust striking outward from left to right and visibly pushing a small opponent silhouette backward; strong directional knockback projectile, not inward suction.
techniques.waterAbsorption: A curved turquoise water shield swallowing one incoming bright energy bolt and converting it into blue droplets of energy returning behind the shield; defensive projectile absorption.
techniques.innerPeace: One simple anonymous seated meditation silhouette surrounded by a warm gold and jade healing aura, tiny lights rising gently from the chest; restorative self-heal, no combat strike.
techniques.purifyingCurrent: A clear turquoise stream washing over an anonymous dark silhouette, lifting and dissolving small violet-green harmful wisps into clean sparkling droplets; cleanse harmful effects, not healing wound imagery.
techniques.razorTorrent: Several razor-sharp mint wind crescents slicing forward in a narrow torrent through a split translucent guard plate, a restrained crimson streak tracing the leading edge; bleeding piercing wind barrage, no gore.

equipment.weapon/concordLaureate: One ornate gold-and-silver long sword with a luminous skyglass edge and a small laurel-shaped guard, dignified tournament reward craftsmanship; no words or crest.
equipment.weapon/tideglassFans: A matched pair of open silver battle fans with turquoise glass panels and gold hinges, arranged as a readable crossed pair; calm object display, no attack wave.
equipment.weapon/conduitSpike: One compact single-point throwing stiletto with a thick blue conduit core and balanced bronze grip, crisp steel point; no three-pronged blade.
equipment.weapon/orbitDisc: One circular bronze-and-silver throwing ring with a sharpened segmented outer rim and a turquoise inner energy ring; no star-shaped blades.
equipment.weapon/frostmereSaber: One long slightly curved silver saber with a subtle frostline along its blade and crimson wrapped grip, northern metalworking; complete weapon in frame.
equipment.weapon/oathknife: One short broad steel dagger with a jade inset in its bronze pommel and dark leather wrapped grip; compact elegant close-range knife.
equipment.weapon/skyforgedBlade: One straight double-edged skyglass sword with a pale cyan beveled edge, restrained silver guard and dark blue grip; complete blade and handle.
equipment.item/laureateShroud: One ornate gold smoke canister with a laurel-patterned metal cap releasing a small controlled violet-gold smoke plume; tournament cosmetic smoke tool, no text.
equipment.item/cinderCharge: One compact bronze explosive charge with an orange glowing crystal core, protective metal bands and a short burning fuse; portable delayed explosive, no paper seal.
equipment.item/spikeCapsule: An open compact dark bronze cartridge case displaying three single-point silver throwing spikes with blue cores; readable consumable pack.
equipment.item/orbitPack: An open small leather-and-metal pouch holding three nested circular silver throwing discs with turquoise inner rings; no star-shaped blades.
equipment.item/poison: One richly textured faceted glass vial of luminous moss-green poison, bronze stopper and a small thorn curling around its base; toxic weapon coating.
equipment.item/veilCanister: One squat navy-and-silver smoke canister releasing a small rich blue-violet cloud, turquoise valve light; protective projectile-blocking smoke tool.
equipment.item/waypointAnchor: One small bronze-and-gold ring-shaped deployable anchor with three short stabilizing fins and a luminous cyan center; a fine golden energy trail connects it to a distant matching point, original recall tool with no written marks.
